summary_md:
# Skanska tar ny miljardorder - Torsten Jansson anar vändning

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börsfrukost den 20 augusti 2026: Stockholmsbörsen stod still kring noll efter elva raka nedgångsdagar, medan Asien steg på SK Hynix rekordstora återköpsprogram och amerikanska räntor föll efter att det amerikanska finansdepartementet köpt obligationer. Huvudfokus var New Waves rapport, som var bättre än väntat men lyft av tullåterföringar. Vd Torsten Jansson lät mer optimistisk, och programledaren menade att tålamod lönar sig trots analytikers risk för nedrevideringar. Övriga ämnen var Karnovs strategiska översyn och möjliga försäljning, Skanskas datacenterorder på nära 12 miljarder kronor i USA, starka rapporter från Ambea och Attendo samt Bures stora substansrabatt.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NEWA-B — New Wave | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host thinks patience will pay: organic growth of 5-6% would lift earnings as investment costs (Dallas, IT, automation) fade. Ålandsbanken expects estimate cuts in the near term.

#### Reasoning

The host disagrees with Ålandsbanken's near-term negative view and sees the quarter as a step towards margin recovery. CEO Torsten Jansson targets 5-6% organic growth, expects the 20% margin in a couple of years, and sees investment effects from H2 next year. The Dallas warehouse opens in October. Near term, tariff refunds flatter margins and the Cotton Classics acquisition dilutes them. Net debt is 3.5bn SEK.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth stays around 2%
- Dallas warehouse ramp-up is delayed or fails
- margin does not move towards 20% within a couple of years
- net debt rises further with acquisitions

> *"Så tålamod kommer nog löna sig här."*

---

### 🟠 KAR — Karnov | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Sale process with Goldman Sachs. Previous bid 84 SEK vs share price 72. Speculation about a bid premium. Shares up 7-12%.

#### Reasoning

The company has publicly opened a sale process, which fuels bid speculation. A failed bid two years ago at 84 SEK is a reference point. Improved margins also counter the market's view that AI will kill software companies. The Q2 report was weak, and there is no guarantee of a deal.

#### Sell Triggers

- sale process ends without a bid
- bid comes in below expectations

> *"en sån här grej kanske spär på spekulationer om att det ska komma i alla fall en premie om man får ett bud"*

---

### 🟠 BURE — Bure | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

NAV 341 SEK vs share price 271 SEK, a large discount that is starting to close. Silex listing a success.

#### Reasoning

The host points to a large NAV discount (about 20%) and recent wins such as the Silex IPO, with the shares rising to narrow the gap. No explicit buy call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- discount widens again
- value of holdings falls

> *"Det är en rejäl rabatt som man nu kanske försöker jaga in lite."*

---

### 🟠 SKA-B — Skanska | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Data-centre order of almost 12bn SEK in the US. Seen as a winner in the data-centre ecosystem, though revenue will come over a long period.

#### Reasoning

The host calls Skanska one of the winners in the data-centre ecosystem after a string of large orders. Revenue will be spread over a long time, so the effect is gradual.

#### Sell Triggers

- data-centre investment slows
- order intake falls

> *"det blev en påminnelse om att de är en av alla vinnare i ekosystemet runt om datacentrum"*

---

### 🟠 ATT — Attendo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stronger report than expected plus a buyback, but shares only +0.4%. Host thinks it was poorly rewarded.

#### Reasoning

The host thinks the market under-rewarded a strong report, with higher occupancy and margins plus a buyback, possibly because Ambea already rose on the same theme the day before.

#### Sell Triggers

- occupancy growth stalls

> *"Lite klent betalt för den rapporten kan jag tycka."*
